entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Mark Peterson. Order number is VF886-091.
Thank you, Mark. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order for the VeloPro cycling shoes. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?
They just don't work for me. They're causing blisters on my heels.
I'm sorry to hear that. Just to be sure, is it a technical fault with the shoes, like with the cleats, or more of a sizing and preference issue?
The cleats are fine. The shoes just hurt. I want a refund.
I understand completely. Comfort is key. Let me just check the policy against your delivery date. One moment.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I see here that the shoes were delivered 25 days ago. You're well within our 90-day return window, so I can definitely process that return for you.
Right. So I can get my money back?

Yes, of course. I have just initiated the return process for a full refund. I've sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. All you'll need to do is box up the cycling shoes and attach that label.
Whatever. I'll get the email soon?
It should be in your inbox within the next five to ten minutes. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, the refund will be processed. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, Mark. Have a good rest of your day.
